---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for GitStart
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## ✨ Feature Summary

> Describe the feature in one or two sentences.

---

## 🧩 Problem It Solves

> What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit from it?

*Example: "As a beginner, I find it hard to understand git rebase because there's no visual explanation..."*

---

## 💡 Proposed Solution

> Describe how you'd like to see this implemented. Be as detailed as you can.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

> Have you thought of any other ways to solve this? Why is your proposed solution better?

---

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

> If you have a sketch, screenshot, or example from another project, share it here.

---

## 📊 Priority / Impact

> How important is this to you?

- [ ] 🔴 High — This blocks my ability to use GitStart effectively
- [ ] 🟡 Medium — This would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] 🟢 Low — Nice to have, but not urgent

---

## 🙋 Would You Like to Work on This?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this feature myself
- [ ] I'd like to collaborate with someone
- [ ] I'm just suggesting — happy for anyone to pick it up

---

## 💬 Additional Context

> Anything else we should know?
